explanation: IsDiameter2Critical requires diam = 2 and that deleting any edge makes diam ≠ 2. Since deleting edges cannot shrink distances, this means the diameter increases or the graph disconnects (Mathlib diam = 0). That matches erdosproblems.com/742. Füredi proved the conjecture for all sufficiently large n. The statement gives n₀ such that every diameter-2-critical graph on n ≥ n₀ vertices has ≤ ⌊n²/4⌋ edges, with a linked Lean proof. Faithful.
